value:
The Dynamic Cordoba DYN-6203-02 FS is a 2-person full spectrum near zero EMF infrared sauna that delivers all three infrared wavelengths — near, mid, and far — in a compact indoor cabin that plugs into a standard 120V/15 AMP outlet. It's a meaningful step up from the Martin in both heating capacity and interior space, while maintaining the same plug-and-play accessibility that makes the Dynamic full spectrum line practical for home installation without a dedicated electrical circuit.

Full spectrum infrared therapy works at every layer of the body simultaneously. FAR infrared is the longest of the three wavelengths and does most of the heating. The panels are rated at 3 MG at 2–3 inches from the heating panels, which is the strict end of how this industry measures — ask any seller for the distance as well as the number. MID infrared sits between the two in wavelength. NEAR infrared is the shortest of the three wavelengths and is absorbed closest to the skin. At near zero EMF under 3 MG measured 2–3 inches from the heating panels, the Cordoba delivers all three wavelengths in an environment that keeps electromagnetic exposure to an absolute minimum — important for buyers who plan extended daily sessions.

The heating system consists of 7 total heaters: 5 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR infrared carbon panels and 2 Near infrared elements, positioned across the rear wall, side walls, under the bench, and on the floor for complete full-body coverage including your feet and lower legs. With a 46" × 41" exterior footprint, the Cordoba is compact enough to fit in a master bedroom, basement, walk-in closet, or home gym while still offering a genuinely comfortable 2-person interior at 42" × 36" × 68".

The interior chromotherapy color lighting system with Red Light Therapy adds coloured light to every infrared session. The interior LED control panel manages temperature, timer, and lighting with ease. Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary audio with 2 built-in dynamic speakers and pre-amp integrates your playlist or podcast seamlessly. The clear tempered glass door keeps the cabin feeling open, and the roof vent maintains proper airflow. The Honey Dark Stain finish on the natural Canadian Hemlock gives the Cordoba a warmer, richer tone than the natural-finish models. Clasp-together panel assembly requires no special tools, and the unit ships in 2 boxes at 300 lbs.

The 120V/15 AMP plug-and-play electrical connection makes installation as simple as having a dedicated 15 AMP outlet available — no electrician required for the sauna itself. This is the same electrical requirement as the Martin, meaning the Cordoba can go anywhere the Martin can, with one more person of capacity and one more heater of coverage.

Dynamic Saunas is produced by Golden Designs, Inc., a California company dedicated to home infrared sauna wellness. The full spectrum FS line uses PureTech™ technology — near zero EMF FAR infrared carbon panels alongside dedicated near infrared elements — for the widest possible infrared therapeutic range in a home-ready format. The 5-year limited warranty covers wood, structure, heating elements, and electronics.
